biggest_catch: You are paid per AUDIO minute, not per hour worked — a 10-minute file can take 40+ minutes to transcribe, so beginners often earn a few dollars per hour of actual work. There is currently an application waitlist and no guaranteed volume of work.
catches: Pay is per audio/video minute of the FILE, not per hour you work — difficult audio takes far longer to type, so effective hourly pay can be very low.
Zero guaranteed tasks: freelancers claim files from a shared job pool; nothing is assigned.
You must pass a graded English skills assessment plus a transcription/caption sample before any paid work — the sample is effectively an unpaid test.
Rev states it currently has an application waitlist due to high volume, with longer response times.
Earnings vary by role, file complexity, and minutes completed; the '$1' catalog figure sits at the TOP of the stated transcription range, not a typical rate.
No minimum commitment cuts both ways: there is no boss, but also no floor on your income.

c1.evidence: Rev — real operating company; official freelancer page on rev.com with three paid roles (transcriptionist, captioner, subtitle translator, legal transcriptionist).

c2.evidence: Official page https://www.rev.com/freelancers states concrete per-minute pay bands per role: transcription $0.40-$1.10, captioning $0.54-$1.10, subtitling $1.70-$4.00+, legal $0.55-$2.00+ per audio/video minute.

c3.evidence: No upfront fee; application is free. Requires a computer, internet, and English skills only.

c4.evidence: Official FAQ: 'Freelancers are paid weekly via PayPal for all approved work.'

eligibility: Anyone who passes the skills assessment and sample; strong English skills required; computer + reliable internet; subtitle roles require fluency in one of the 17 listed languages. Waitlist currently applies — applications processed in order received.

steps: Go to https://www.rev.com/freelancers and choose a role: Transcriptionist ($0.40-$1.10/audio min), Captioner ($0.54-$1.10/audio min), or Subtitle Translator ($1.70-$4.00+/audio min).
Submit the application form (note the current waitlist — applications are processed in order received).
Complete the short skills assessment covering English proficiency and grammar.
Submit a short transcription/caption/translation sample meeting Rev's quality standards.
Once approved, log in and claim audio/video files from the job pool — you choose when and how much you work.
Submit completed work before deadlines; approved work is paid weekly via PayPal.
timing: Paid weekly via PayPal for all approved work.
